hook_en: Your times are in His hands. 🙏
reflect_en: This Sunday, before a new week and a new month begin, say it with David: You are my God. Every day ahead is held in His hands, and His face shines on you with loving devotion.
q_en: What do you need to place in His hands this week?
x_en: But I trust in You, O LORD; I say, “You are my God.” My times are in Your hands
tiktok: My times are in Your hands 🙏 Psalm 31:14–16 — a Sunday reset for a brand-new month
yt_title: My Times Are in Your Hands | Psalm 31:14–16 #Shorts
li_open: A new month starts tomorrow. Whose hands is your calendar in?
li_quote: But I trust in You, O LORD; I say, “You are my God.” My times are in Your hands
li_body: Leaders plan carefully, and we should. But David reminds us that our times rest in God's hands, not ours. Planning from trust instead of pressure frees us to care for the people we serve and to pray for them, one week at a time.
hook_es: Tus tiempos están en Sus manos. 🙏
reflect_es: Este domingo, antes de empezar una nueva semana y un nuevo mes, dile como David: Dios mío eres tú. Cada día que viene está en Su mano, y Él hace resplandecer Su rostro sobre ti.
q_es: ¿Qué necesitas poner en Sus manos esta semana?
x_es: Mas yo en ti confié, oh Jehová: yo dije: Dios mío eres tú. En tu mano están mis tiempos
key_en: My times are in Your hands
key_es: En tu mano están mis tiempos
